summary: New payment-flow module ships with 0% coverage. No red-first, no boundary tests, no failure-path tests.

findings.message: issue_partial_refund calls Stripe and writes to two DB rows; ships with no test file. Coverage: 0%.
findings.suggestion: Add tests/test_refund_service.py covering: (1) happy path, (2) amount > order.total raises ValueError, (3) stripe.refund raises → local Refund row rolled back.

findings.message: No failing test committed before implementation. TDD requires the test to fail first so it's proven to exercise the code.
findings.suggestion: Revert the impl commit, add the test file with expected assertions, verify it FAILS in CI, then re-add the impl.
